newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock funds post outflows for 2-day period.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock funds post outflows for 2-day period.

text.p: U.S. stock funds posted estimated industry outflows of $708 million for the two days ended April 14 compared with inflows of $1.57 billion for the three-day period ended April 10, according to a survey by Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm reported aggressive growth funds had outflows of $537 million versus inflows of $4 million, growth funds had outflows of $335 million versus inflows of $424 million, and growth and income funds had inflows of $249 million versus inflows of $1.13 billion.

Bond funds posted outflows of $712 million versus inflows of $338 million. Muni funds had outflows of $581 million versus inflows of $281 million, while corporate/income/global had outflows of $60 million versus inflows of $19 million. Government/GNMA funds reduced outflows to $54 million from $137 million.
